title: Network-based machine learning in colorectal and bladder organoid models predicts anti-cancer drug efficacy in patients.
summary: The primary study combines network-based pathway selection and deep neural response models in colorectal and bladder organoids, then reports associations between predicted drug-response biomarkers and patient survival, with negative controls and cell-line validation. This is retrospective translational evidence, not prospective treatment-selection utility.
ai_technology: PMC/publisher full Methods and Results: 19 colorectal and 9 bladder organoid samples; survival associations in treated cohorts (114 CRC/5-FU; 77 bladder/cisplatin), absent in untreated negative controls, plus isogenic sensitive/resistant cell-line validation.
